UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user sync profile container without raw PII exposure.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning this profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

TtxWorkspace.title: TtxWorkspace
TtxWorkspace.description: Synchronized Tabletop Exercise scenario state including blocks, dialogues/narratives, SOP items, incident narrative, and played status.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier matching the document ID.

dialogues.description: Ordered list of dialogues and interleaved block narratives (max 500).

sopItems.description: Ordered list of emergency SOP unit items (max 200).

incidentNarrative.description: Editable Bagian IV incident dynamics narrative object.

playedIds.description: List of dialogue IDs marked as played (max 500).

sopPositions.description: Optional per-phase 0-based slot index positioning the SOP panel among communication blocks (keys: fase-2, fase-3, fase-4, fase-6; integer values 0 to 100).

scenarioMeta.description: Optional editable scenario header metadata (unit, title, description, status, callSign, aircraft, route, etaRunway, pob, fuel).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest workspace update.

AudioAssetMeta.title: AudioAssetMeta
AudioAssetMeta.description: Metadata document for a dialogue audio file stored in chunked subcollection documents.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dialogueId.description: Dialogue ID matching the audio document ID.

size.description: Original binary size in bytes (1 to 10485760).

chunkCount.description: Number of base64 chunks in the chunks subcollection (1 to 30).

revision.description: Unique revision identifier updated whenever audio is replaced.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when audio metadata was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when audio metadata was last updated.

AudioChunk.title: AudioChunk
AudioChunk.description: A single base64-encoded chunk of a dialogue audio file (<= 512KB per document).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

revision.description: Revision matching the parent AudioAssetMeta document.

data.description: Base64 payload slice for this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was last updated.

WorkspaceSavestate.title: WorkspaceSavestate
WorkspaceSavestate.description: Named full snapshot of the TTX scenario including blocks, dialogues/narratives, SOP items, SOP positions, incident narrative, played IDs, and content-addressed audio asset references.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the savestate owner.

savestateId.description: Savestate identifier matching the document ID.

name.description: User-defined label for this savestate (e.g. Versi Original).

note.description: Optional short note describing this savestate.

dialogues.description: Snapshot list of dialogues and interleaved block narratives (max 500).

sopItems.description: Snapshot list of emergency SOP unit items (max 200).

sopPositions.description: Per-phase 0-based slot index positioning the SOP panel among communication blocks.

incidentNarrative.description: Snapshot of Bagian IV incident dynamics narrative.

playedIds.description: Snapshot list of dialogue IDs marked as played (max 500).

audioRefs.description: Snapshot list of audio references mapping dialogueId to immutable savestateAudios assetId (max 500).

scenarioMeta.description: Optional snapshot of editable scenario header metadata.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when savestate was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when savestate was last updated.

SavestateAudioMeta.title: SavestateAudioMeta
SavestateAudioMeta.description: Immutable metadata document for a deduplicated audio vault blob referenced by one or more savestates.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

assetId.description: Unique immutable audio asset ID matching the document ID.

size.description: Original binary size in bytes (1 to 10485760).

chunkCount.description: Number of base64 chunks in the chunks subcollection (1 to 30).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when asset was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when asset was last updated.

SavestateAudioChunk.title: SavestateAudioChunk
SavestateAudioChunk.description: A single base64-encoded chunk of an immutable savestate audio vault asset (<= 512KB per document).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

assetId.description: Parent savestate audio asset document ID.

data.description: Base64 payload slice for this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was last updated.

AdminEntry.title: AdminEntry
AdminEntry.description: Authorized Google account email granted Admin write privileges over the shared TTX scenario.

email.description: Lowercase Google account email matching the document ID.

addedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin who created this entry.

note.description: Optional facilitator name or role note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

SharedTtxWorkspace.title: SharedTtxWorkspace
SharedTtxWorkspace.description: Published shared TTX scenario workspace readable by all Users and writable exclusively by verified Admins.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin who last published an update.

dialogues.description: Ordered list of dialogues and interleaved block narratives (max 500).

sopItems.description: Ordered list of emergency SOP unit items (max 200).

sopPositions.description: Per-phase 0-based slot index positioning the SOP panel among communication blocks.

incidentNarrative.description: Editable Bagian IV incident dynamics narrative object.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when shared workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest Admin update.

SharedAudioAssetMeta.title: SharedAudioAssetMeta
SharedAudioAssetMeta.description: Published audio metadata for a dialogue or narrative readable by all Users and writable exclusively by verified Admins.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin who uploaded or updated this audio.

dialogueId.description: Dialogue or narrative ID matching the audio document ID.

size.description: Original binary size in bytes (1 to 10485760).

chunkCount.description: Number of base64 chunks in the chunks subcollection (1 to 30).

revision.description: Unique revision identifier updated whenever audio is replaced.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when published audio metadata was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when published audio metadata was last updated.

SharedAudioChunk.title: SharedAudioChunk
SharedAudioChunk.description: A single base64-encoded chunk of a published shared audio file (<= 512KB per document).

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin who wrote this chunk.

revision.description: Revision matching the parent SharedAudioAssetMeta document.

data.description: Base64 payload slice for this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when chunk was last updated.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Registry of Google account emails authorized as Admin (self-check get or Admin read/write).

/sharedWorkspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Published shared TTX scenario state readable by all Users and writable exclusively by Admins.

/sharedWorkspaces/{workspaceId}/audios/{.description: Published metadata records for shared TTX dialogue and narrative audio files.
Chunked base64 slices of published shared TTX audio files.

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Owner-isolated synchronized TTX scenario workspace state.
Metadata records for synchronized dialogue audio files.
Chunked base64 slices of synchronized dialogue audio files.
Named full snapshots of TTX scenarios referencing deduplicated savestate audio assets.
Immutable metadata records for deduplicated audio blobs referenced by savestates.
